# The oracle the benchmarks run as the `python` engine (cargo xtask bench,
# xtask/src/bench/oracle.rs): opentide 0.23.0, the frozen tag, from its PyPI
# wheels, with every dependency pinned and every file's SHA-256. uv refuses a
# file whose hash differs (--require-hashes). Regenerate only to move the
# oracle, in a change of its own, and re-record tests/bench/budgets.toml:
#
#   echo 'opentide==0.23.0' > oracle.in
#   uv pip compile oracle.in --universal --python-version 3.10 --generate-hashes \
#     --exclude-newer 2026-11-07T00:00:00Z --no-header -o tests/bench/oracle-requirements.txt
#
# (then restore this header). The opentide hashes are the ones PyPI lists for
# opentide 0.23.0's wheels and sdist (https://pypi.org/project/opentide/0.23.0/#files).
